open_points.subject: Create replay after an ordinary record change
open_points.text: This holds while the record the first create made keeps its values
open_points.question: Which retained values preserve replay recognition, and do corrections, restriction, relationship changes or archiving end it, or only erasure/anonymisation that removes the stored create request id?
options: Replay recognition survives ordinary changes and ends only when the create-identifying facts are erased.
Any change to the created record's values ends replay recognition, so the repeated request is a new create.
open_points.default_guess: Replay recognition survives ordinary changes while the written-once create request id remains.

witness.initial: The owner records Customer C with request id R; C has its original contact data and revision 1.
events: The owner corrects C's phone, moving it to revision 2.
The owner repeats the original record-customer request with request id R after losing or retrying the earlier answer.
outcomes: Registry recognizes R and returns the existing, corrected Customer C without creating another Customer.
Because C no longer keeps the values made by the first create, Registry treats the repeat as a new create and mints Customer C2.
witness.observer: The owner sees either one customer or two in the customer list.

open_points.subject: Project-create replay after whole deletion
open_points.text: Erasing a customer or anonymising a project removes everything that would tell a repeat; a create repeated after that is a new create
open_points.question: Does deleting an archived project whole also make a later repetition of its create request a new create, or is the new exception limited to customer erasure and project anonymisation?
options: Whole deletion also removes replay recognition, and the repeated request creates a new project.
Only the two named cases lose replay recognition; a repeated create after whole deletion must still be recognized or refused without creating a project.
open_points.default_guess: Whole deletion also makes the repetition a new create because the original record and its request id are gone.

witness.initial: Project P was created with request id R and is active.
events: The owner confirms deletion of P whole.
The owner repeats the original create-project request with request id R.
outcomes: Registry treats the request as new and mints project P2.
Registry preserves the old replay guarantee despite P's deletion and does not create P2.
witness.observer: The owner sees either a newly created project or no new project.

open_points.subject: Fresh validation of a project create repeated after anonymisation
open_points.text: a create repeated after that is a new create, and its answer shows the new record it made
open_points.question: When a repeated project create is treated as new after anonymisation, must it pass the current create preconditions, or must it always make the promised new record even if its original customer reference is now erased, restricted or ended?
options: It is a fully fresh create and is refused when a current precondition fails.
It must create and return a new project as stated, bypassing a newly failing customer precondition.
open_points.default_guess: Apply all current create preconditions and refuse when one fails.

witness.initial: Customer C is usable, and the owner creates project P naming C with request id R.
events: The owner archives and anonymises P.
The owner repeats P's original create request with request id R, still naming C.
outcomes: As a new create, the request is refused because no project may newly name a restricted customer.
The repeated create makes and returns a new project because the added passage says its answer shows the new record it made.
witness.observer: The owner sees either a refusal or a second project linked to restricted Customer C.
